description.value:
Requirement You are wielding a loaded chemical or incendiary weapon.

Area 60-foot line

Duration 1 minute

Doorways, alleys, stairwells. Anywhere the world has already decided where people have to walk.

Lay the line down and leave it there. The whole line becomes hazardous ground for the duration. A creature that begins its turn in the line is also sickened 1, and cannot reduce that condition while it remains in the area. Difficult terrain and narrow spaces do not interrupt the line; it goes where the corridor goes.

cinderfall.incomplete: This card's entire effect is a limited-use activated action/reaction that hands the actor a wholly new usable action -- per this pass's fixed bucket-3 convention this is always INCOMPLETE regardless of precedent. Ironsight's own real-world analog, the Gunslinger, ships this exact shape unencoded across dozens of its own Strike-variant/reload-trick/called-shot feats (e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/gunslinger/level-10/called-shot.json, level-6/scatter-blast.json, level-1/dual-weapon-reload.json, all rules: []) -- confirming this is the standard shape for a gunfighter class, not license to SKIP. This effect is defined entirely in terms of a Cinderfall-homebrew subsystem with zero Foundry schema footprint (the Gun Failure Table/Failure Range, hazardous ground, time-in-sights, Trick Iron charge bank, or Drift/augment-slot cost). Confirmed via the full rule-element type listing (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/, 40 files): no RollTable-manipulation, no persistent-terrain-hazard, and no arbitrary stacking-counter rule element type exists to hook any of these to. This is a cross-creature effect: it changes a DIFFERENT creature's own roll, HP, condition, healing, or item from the actor's own passive or activated ability, with no companion linked Effect item in this corpus to carry it (unlike the six real *-effect cards this class does have). No selector exists for this anywhere in pf2e-source.
